# SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — NOT the real WWN SRD.
#
# This file mimics the *text layout* of the Worlds Without Number SRD §3.0.0
# equipment chapter so the extraction tool (story 114-3) can be exercised in
# unit tests without depending on the real, out-of-repo SRD PDF
# (~/Documents/DriveThruRPG/...). The rows below are invented, schema-shaped
# stand-ins that exercise every parser branch:
#
#   * a melee weapon (damage + shock)
#   * a ranged weapon (damage + range band + magazine)
#   * an armor entry (armor class)
#   * a piece of general gear (no combat envelope)
#
# Section headers, column order, and the "Damage  Shock" / "Range  Mag" column
# conventions mirror the WWN SRD presentation. Values are deliberately NOT the
# real SRD numbers — this is a parser fixture, not bound content.
